slides.heading: Reception — Spring 2, Week 2
slides.sub: New sounds taught directly, practised and applied in words, captions and the matching decodable book.

slides.heading: Mon
slides.objective: Learn the new sound "ar" (/ɑː/) and start reading and spelling words that use it.

slides.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="320" height="320" role="img" aria-label="car" class="wp-icon wp-raster" data-picture="car"><image href="data:image/png;base64," x="0" y="0" width="100" height="100" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet"/></svg>

slides.mnemonic: Arlo the fox opens his mouth wide and lets out a long, low ar-ar under the starry sky.

character.name: Arlo
character.blurb: Arlo is a bright evening star who lets out a long, low twinkle-sound whenever the sky goes dark.

slides.pronunciation_note: A long, open sound, 'ar' as in 'car' — open your mouth wide and let it drop back, hold it for a moment.
slides.formation_cue: Write 'a', then 'r', close together — two letters, one sound.
slides.action: Open your mouth wide, tip your head back to look at the sky, and hold ar-ar.
slides.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="320" height="320" role="img" aria-label="car" class="wp-icon wp-raster" data-picture="car"><image href="data:image/png;base64," x="0" y="0" width="100" height="100" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet"/></svg>

slides.tip: The 'ey' ending makes a long 'ai' sound, not two separate sounds — practise it alongside 'grey' so the pattern feels familiar.

slides.heading: Tue
slides.objective: Learn the new sound "or" (/ɔː/) and start reading and spelling words that use it.

slides.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="320" height="320" role="img" aria-label="corn" class="wp-icon wp-raster" data-picture="corn"><image href="data:image/png;base64," x="0" y="0" width="100" height="100" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet"/></svg>

slides.mnemonic: Orin the owl rounds his beak into a small O and calls a long or-or before he swoops down.

character.name: Orin
character.blurb: Orin always rounds his beak into a tiny O shape and gives a long or-or call before he ever swoops.

slides.pronunciation_note: A long, rounded sound, 'or' as in 'for' — round your lips more than 'ar' and hold it steady.
slides.formation_cue: Write 'o', then 'r', close together — two letters, one sound.
slides.action: Round your lips into a small O, mime swooping one arm downward, and say or-or.
slides.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="320" height="320" role="img" aria-label="corn" class="wp-icon wp-raster" data-picture="corn"><image href="data:image/png;base64," x="0" y="0" width="100" height="100" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet"/></svg>

slides.dictation: The horn is on the car.

slides.heading: Wed
slides.objective: Learn the new sound "ur" (/ɜː/) and start reading and spelling words that use it.

slides.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="320" height="320" role="img" aria-label="fur" class="wp-icon wp-raster" data-picture="fur"><image href="data:image/png;base64," x="0" y="0" width="100" height="100" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet"/></svg>

slides.mnemonic: Ursula the hedgehog curls into a tight ball and hums a low, steady ur-ur while she rests.

character.name: Ursula
character.blurb: Ursula curls into a tight round ball whenever she's resting and hums a low, steady note.

slides.pronunciation_note: A long, low sound made in the middle of the mouth, 'ur' as in 'burn' — lips slightly rounded, hold it steady like a purr.
slides.formation_cue: Write 'u', then 'r', close together — two letters, one sound.
slides.action: Hug your arms around yourself like curling into a ball and hum a low, steady ur-ur.
slides.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="320" height="320" role="img" aria-label="fur" class="wp-icon wp-raster" data-picture="fur"><image href="data:image/png;base64," x="0" y="0" width="100" height="100" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet"/></svg>

slides.heading: Thu
slides.objective: Extra practice blending and segmenting everything taught this week — no new content today.

slides.heading: Fri
slides.objective: Revisit everything taught this week, read the matched decodable book, and check how securely it has been learned.

slides.dictation: A cart is in the yard.
